newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Len Cheong debuts at 6.30 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Len Cheong debuts at 6.30 ringgit.

text.p: Malaysian furniture maker Len Cheong Holding Bhd listed on Friday on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board at 6.30 ringgit, against a 2.00 ringgit offer price.
At 0135 GMT, the company's stock was trading at 6.90 ringgit. It had made a public issue of 2.38 million shares and offered for sale an additional 3.68 million shares.
For the year ended December 31, 1996, Len Cheong reported turnover of 27.42 million ringgit, pre-tax profit of 7.04 million and net profit of 5.40 million or 17 cents a share.
It has forecast a pre-tax profit of 7.40 million ringgit and net profit of 5.46 million or 16.1 cents a share for calendar 1997.

The public share issue and share offer are expected to raise total gross proceeds of 12.11 million ringgit. The public issue gross proceeds of 4.75 million ringgit will be used for working capital, repayment of bank debt and listing expenses.
Len Cheong makes rubberwood furniture including table tops, chairs, as well as other wood-based products including kiln-dried timber, laminated board, veneer and frames.
